## Outcome

I did not push a major feature this week. Most of my time went into checking the proposals from Week 3 and waiting for feedback.

## What I Did

- Confirmed that PR #337 repaired leaked browser state instead of increasing every timeout.
- Compared the GitHub Pages permissions failure with the earlier shared-repository race.
- Checked whether the `atime` problem belonged in Animint2 or upstream workflow behavior.
- Continued checking how a second facet-label line changes the space around a panel.

## Learnings

Finding a cause and choosing the repository that should own the fix turned out to be two separate decisions.

## Challenges / Notes

The CI page made unrelated failures look like one problem. I kept the browser, credentials, package, and SVG work separate while review continued.

## Next Week Targets

Reduce the open branches to the smallest reviewable changes and wait for maintainer decisions on the two CI proposals.

## Demo / Media

::: {.decision-path}
